pages.text: Tomorrow was the kindergarten party. The children cut colored paper to make loops.
"My chain must be longest." Gaga joined loops one by one.
Duri's chain stretched across the table. Gaga broke off its end and joined it to their own chain.
Gaga tore half of Lala's chain away too. "My chain is longest."
Gaga's chain drooped to the floor. Only short pieces remained on the friends' tables.
Duri took their chain back. Lala and Bobo took their own pieces back too.
Gaga's chain grew shorter with each break. Only three loops remained in their hand.
Teacher Bau set down a stack of colored paper. "Your chain grows when you join your own loops."
Gaga cut paper and joined loops. Beside Gaga, the friends made their own too.
They joined five chains into one. It went all the way around the classroom. Holding an end, Gaga grinned.
